comment: The missed comparison was E<B: B’s 100× larger lr/(1−momentum) did not compensate for its deep plain, early-only-LN architecture. E’s residual paths plausibly preserve input-dependent features and gradients better, but the revealed ranking does not establish that mechanism. I overextended K1019’s progress calibration across topologies; K1012 and K1015 warned against this, while K1008 could not distinguish two LeakyReLU candidates. Backtesting found no matching historical ranking pairs. Lab deep-rectifier SGD comparisons favored residuals in only 15/29 pairs across 13 sets; the sole ≥10× slower-residual comparison won, but equal-rate comparisons reversed frequently. This supports reconsidering topology, not a validated residual-first rule.
